why: Database-backed services under src/lib whose exported symbols nothing under src/app/api imports, following the import graph through barrel re-exports and service-to-service chains. Resolution is SYMBOL-level: a route importing a barrel does not count as using every service that barrel re-exports, because the question is whether a FEATURE is exposed, not whether a module gets loaded. Each entry is either a route to add (the feature works, expose it) or a deletion to propose (the feature is dead). UNREVIEWED entries are debt nobody has looked at yet. This list may only shrink. Namespace, default and side-effect imports still count as whole-module, so the audit errs toward missing a stranded service rather than accusing a working one.
